name: FSL Top-up & Eddy Correct - w/fMAP
summary: Corrects DWI for susceptibility distortions, eddy currents and motion with FSL topup and eddy, using a reverse phase-encoded DWI or an AP/PA EPI field-map pair, and outputs the corrected DWI and a brain mask.
description: Estimates the susceptibility field with FSL topup from opposite phase-encoded b0 images (taken from the reverse-PE DWI or from AP/PA EPI field maps), then runs eddy (eddy_openmp, or eddy_cuda when requested) with that field to correct motion and eddy currents. Use it as the main preprocessing step for DWI acquired with a reverse phase-encoding scan or EPI field maps. It needs the primary DWI with bvals/bvecs plus one opposite-PE source; a brain mask is computed from the corrected mean b0. Do not use it if no opposite phase-encoded data exist.

inputs.description: Primary DWI series (with bvals and bvecs) to correct.
inputs.requirements: PhaseEncodingDirection and TotalReadoutTime must be available from the dataset metadata or the encode/param parameters.

inputs.description: DWI acquired with the reverse phase-encoding direction; its b0 volumes are paired with those of diff to estimate the TOPUP field.
inputs.requirements: Optional if an AP/PA EPI field-map pair is given; must have the same number of slices as diff unless reslice is true.

inputs.description: Field-map dataset; only an AP/PA EPI pair (epi1/epi2 with JSON sidecars) is used, as an alternative source of opposite-phase b0 images for TOPUP.
inputs.requirements: epi1_json and epi2_json must contain PhaseEncodingDirection and TotalReadoutTime.

outputs.description: The brainmask of the preprocessed DWI
Intermediate topup and eddy files (field estimates, acquisition parameters, eddy outputs) kept for inspection.

parameters.description:
Phase encoding direction of the diff (not rdiff), i.e. first, inputted dwi.

for example, if the phase encoding direction of the first inputted dwi is 'PA', then select 'PA'. If it was 'AP', then select 'AP'

parameters.description:
This is the 'dwell time'. Please see https://fsl.fmrib.ox.ac.uk/fsl/fslwiki/eddy/Faq#How_do_I_know_what_to_put_into_my_--acqp_file for more information about this specific parameter.
If not set, the app will try to estimate this value from the metadata.
topup: (approximate) resolution (in mm) of warp basis for the different sub-sampling levels
topup: sub-sampling scheme
topup: FWHM (in mm) of gaussian smoothing kernel
topup: number of iterations
topup: Weight of regularisation
topup: If set (=1), lambda is weighted by current ssq
topup: Model for regularisation of warp-field
topup: Estimate movements if set
topup: Minimisation method 0=Levenberg-Marquardt, 1=Scaled Conjugate Gradient
topup: Order of spline, 2->Qadratic spline, 3->Cubic spline
topup: Precision for representing Hessian, double or float
topup: Image interpolation model, linear or spline
topup: If set (=1), the images are individually scaled to a common mean
topup: If set (=1), the calculations are done in a different grid
Eddy-correct: reference volume to align everything to
If true, the reverse phase-encoded DWI is merged with the primary DWI and both are passed to eddy; otherwise only the primary DWI is corrected. Requires rdif.
If, for whatever reason, the two DWI images do not have the same number of slices, set reslice to true and it will reslice the rdif image to diff
If enabled, the application performs skull stripping on the DWI data to generate a brain mask for use during the top-up step.

If set to true, the pipeline will use eddy_cuda instead of eddy_openmp to perform motion and eddy-current correction.
eddy_cuda enables GPU acceleration of the EDDY step and can substantially reduce processing time on compatible systems.

Set to true only if the diffusion acquisition is approximately multi-shell or single-shell, as expected by FSL eddy --data_is_shelled. Leave as false for non-shelled acquisitions (for example DSI or other irregular q-space sampling), since forcing this option on unsuitable data can cause eddy to fail.

failure_modes.message: ERROR: No epi1/epi2 and no rdif available (no opposite-PE pair for topup).
failure_modes.cause: Neither a reverse phase-encoded DWI nor an AP/PA EPI field-map pair was provided.
failure_modes.fix: Provide the rdif input or a fieldmap dataset with epi1/epi2.

failure_modes.message: ERROR: mergefull=true but rdif/rbvc/rbvl are not provided in config.json.
failure_modes.cause: mergefull requires the reverse phase-encoded DWI.
failure_modes.fix: Provide rdif or set mergefull to false.

failure_modes.message: ERROR: epi1_json/epi2_json missing PhaseEncodingDirection or TotalReadoutTime.
failure_modes.cause: The EPI field-map sidecars lack required metadata.
failure_modes.fix: Add PhaseEncodingDirection and TotalReadoutTime to the EPI JSON sidecars.

failure_modes.message: ERROR: param must be numeric TotalReadoutTime in seconds
failure_modes.cause: The readout time could not be read from metadata and param is not a number.
failure_modes.fix: Set param to the total readout time in seconds.
